CREATE TABLE "public"."order" (
  "adminNote" text,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "confirmedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerEmail" text,
  "customerName" text NOT NULL,
  "customerNote" text,
  "customerPhone" text NOT NULL,
  "deliveredAt" timestamptz,
  "discountAmount" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "grandTotal" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "orderNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentMethod" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentStatus" text DEFAULT 'UNPAID' NOT NULL,
  "placedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "shippedAt" timestamptz,
  "shippingCharge" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "shippingMethodId" int4,
  "shippingMethodName" text,
  "shippingZoneId" int4,
  "shippingZoneName" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "taxAmount" numeric(12,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "order_paymentMethod_check_191ce658" CHECK ("paymentMethod" IN ('CASH_ON_DELIVERY', 'ONLINE')),
  CONSTRAINT "order_paymentStatus_check_991aa452" CHECK ("paymentStatus" IN ('UNPAID', 'PENDING', 'PAID', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED')),
  CONSTRAINT "order_status_check_90625984" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'PROCESSING', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_address" (
  "addressLine1" text NOT NULL,
  "addressLine2" text,
  "area" text,
  "countryCode" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "district" text NOT NULL,
  "division" text,
  "fullName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "orderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "postalCode" text,
  "thana" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "upazila" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "order_address_type_check_f199e0c6" CHECK ("type" IN ('SHIPPING', 'BILLING'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_item" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lineTotal" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "orderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4,
  "productName" text NOT NULL,
  "productSlug" text,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sku" text NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "variantId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_item_attribute" (
  "attributeName" text NOT NULL,
  "attributeValue" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "orderItemId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_status_history" (
  "changedById" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fromStatus" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "orderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "toStatus" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "order_status_history_fromStatus_check_2e0eb1b3" CHECK ("fromStatus" IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'PROCESSING', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "order_status_history_toStatus_check_b4a330f1" CHECK ("toStatus" IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'PROCESSING', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED'))
)
